newsitem.title: USA: Iatros Health Network awarded contract.
newsitem.headline: Iatros Health Network awarded contract.

text.p: Iatros Health Network Inc said Monday that a subsidiary has been hired by Ravenwood Healthcare Inc to manage a 358-bed nursing home in Baltimore.
The contract is expected to generate more than $1 million for Iatros subsidiary Greenbrier Healthcare Services Inc in the first year, the company said.
The project generated a development fee of $150,000 and a construction-oversight fee of $250,000, which was paid to Greenbrier at closing.
Greenbrier also will receive annual management fees of about 5 percent of Ravenwood's gross revenues.
For the first 12 months of operations, the management fee is estimated to be about $715,000.
